image_description: A traditional maypole scene outdoors. A tall, slender wooden pole stands in the center, topped with a floral wreath. Long, multi-colored ribbons (streamers) extend from the top to the ground, where they are held by a group of people (mostly children and some adults) dressed in light-colored or white clothing. The participants are arranged in a circle around the pole, appearing to be in the process of dancing or weaving the ribbons. The background features green trees and a building with a dark roof.
